name: fight-night-watchdog
problem: Social media posts after big UFC/boxing/combat sports events require manual triggering — missing the news cycle window and requiring the PC to be on.

agent.name: fight-night-watchdog
agent.description: Monitors for fight results on combat sports event nights and posts immediately to Instagram, Facebook, and Twitter/X.

rubric_criteria: Results detected within 10 min of appearing on ESPN/MMA Fighting
All key facts accurate — winner, method, round, time, event
No duplicates — memory store confirms result not previously posted
Posted to all 3 platforms: Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X

deployment.notes: Every 10 min all-day Fri + Sat UTC (covers Fri/Sat night fight windows in US timezones). Agent exits early if no event tonight. Manual trigger for PPV nights on other days.

memory_store.name: fight-results-memory
memory_store.description: Tracks posted fight results to prevent duplicate posts across sessions
